name: Viewpoint Neighborhood Kitchen
notes: Restaurant's own site embeds its printed menu via iMenuPro widgets (imenupro.com/!3wx-l1, !3wx-l4, !3wx-l3, !3wx-l5 for Breakfast/Brunch/Lunch&Dinner/Dessert respectively); fetched each script directly and parsed the embedded HTML payload rather than rendering the page. Drink/cocktail menu is a separate PDF (viewpoint-dessert-cocktail-menu-june-2026.pdf) and was not itemized here since it carries no food items. All 80 prices are whole dollars ($5-$40), consistent with a casino-resort restaurant menu. Deduped by coordinator from 80 to 44 rows (same name+price repeated across sections).
